purpose: Persist review proposition state beyond transient monitor-artifact retention without granting the live monitor or Pages routine repository-write authority.

architecture.retained_delta_source: post-checkpoint retained monitor artefacts reduced through review_candidate_state_contract.json

identity.rule: Use the proposition identity defined by review_candidate_state_contract.json; checkpointing must never generate a second identity for the same proposition.

merge_rules: Only monitor evidence strictly after covered_through_monitor_run_number may be added as checkpoint delta evidence.
A checkpoint item persists when absent from a later retained delta.
The same review_item_id updates the existing proposition rather than creating a duplicate.
A materially different proposition remains a sibling review_item_id.
Observation counts may advance only from monitor runs not already covered by the prior checkpoint.
Manual reviewed decisions are reapplied during checkpoint proposal generation.
Canonical alignment without a linked reviewed change-ledger item remains CANONICAL_ALIGNMENT_REQUIRES_RECONCILIATION.
A COMMITTED state requires an explicit origin_review_item_id link in the reviewed canonical change ledger.
No v0.1 checkpoint item is deleted merely because it is old, absent, rejected, deferred, superseded or committed.
Raw source snapshots, parser errors, old/new evidence payloads, source assertions, legal rules and topology payloads must never enter the checkpoint.

required_preconditions: Exact prior review_checkpoint.json SHA-256 matches the reviewed proposal precondition.
Canonical registry, source registry, schema, monitor expectations, monitor operations policy and change ledger are hash-protected during the checkpoint transaction.
Proposed checkpoint validates against this contract and contains no prohibited fields.
Only data/monitor/review_checkpoint.json may change in the checkpoint transaction.
Full WORLD SIGNALS CI passes before commit.

retention_safety.checkpoint_policy: Create and review a checkpoint before uncheckpointed evidence approaches artefact expiry. The v0.1 architecture does not yet schedule automatic checkpoint writes.
retention_safety.failure_rule: If evidence required to advance the checkpoint has expired or is incomplete, do not infer candidate absence and do not advance covered_through_monitor_run_number across the gap.

platform_independence: The checkpoint is a versioned JSON operational-state dataset. GitHub Actions is the current transport/implementation, not the conceptual persistence model.
